description_en: Modifies the risk scan configuration for image build instructions
description_zh: 修改镜像构建指令风险扫描配置
name: SetBuildRiskDefineRuleConfig

parameters.help_en:
The risk items in the risk scan configuration for image build instructions. Valid values:
classKey: the ClassKey field value from RuleTree
ruleList: the RuleKey field values under RuleList
Call the [GetBuildRiskDefineRuleConfig](~~GetBuildRiskDefineRuleConfig~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
镜像构建指令风险扫描配置风险项。取值：
classKey：取RuleTree的ClassKey字段值
ruleList：取RuleList下的RuleKey字段值
调用[GetBuildRiskDefineRuleConfig](~~GetBuildRiskDefineRuleConfig~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: config

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Id.description_en: The ID of the risk scan configuration for image build instructions
Id.description_zh: 镜像构建指令风险扫描配置ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
